core.inspect.broken: ⚠ {count} file(s) are unreadable or corrupt ({names}) — they will be skipped
core.inspect.width_spread: ⚠ Image widths vary a lot ({minimum}px to {maximum}px) — they will be resized to match, but check whether these images belong together
core.inspect.odd_size: ⚠ {count} image(s) differ greatly in size from the rest ({names}) — often a cover, an ad or an insert; worth a look
core.inspect.output_inside_input: ⚠ The output folder sits inside the source folder ({folder}) — already-stitched files may be picked up again next run. Use a separate output folder.
core.export.no_alpha: {fmt} does not support alpha; it will be flattened onto the configured background
core.export.no_icc: {fmt} does not support ICC profiles; the profile will be dropped
core.export.no_exif: {fmt} does not support EXIF; metadata will be dropped
core.export.over_limit: ⚠ {fmt} supports at most {limit_w} × {limit_h} px — part {index} would be {width} × {height} px, which exceeds the limit and will fail to save. Reduce the size per file or switch to PNG.
core.error.bad_orientation: orientation must be one of {allowed}, not {value}
core.error.bad_format: fmt must be one of {allowed}, not {value}
core.error.no_encoder: No {fmt} encoder in the running Pillow
core.error.bad_multi_frame: multi_frame must be first, all or error
core.error.not_an_image: Not an image Pillow can read: {path}
core.error.multi_frame_rejected: {path} has {frames} frames but the policy accepts single-frame images only
core.error.bad_preset_name: A preset name must not be empty or contain forbidden characters
pipeline.name: stitch
